SELECT 
    qs.cognitive_score,
    CASE WHEN qs.cognitive_score < 73.93 - 3*20.5 THEN 'LOW' 
         WHEN qs.cognitive_score > 73.93 + 3*20.5 THEN 'HIGH' 
         ELSE 'NORMAL' END as cognitive_outlier_status
FROM measurements qs
JOIN (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog, AVG(cognitive_score)*AVG(cognitive_score)-AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score)/(COUNT(*)) as variance FROM measurements) vars ON qs.cognitive_score IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_rxn, MIN(reaction_ms) as min_rxn, MAX(reaction_ms) as max_rxn, 
    (AVG(reaction_ms)*AVG(reaction_ms)-AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms)/(COUNT(*))) as variance FROM measurements;

ATTACH DATABASE ':memory:' AS temp_db;

CREATE TABLE measurements_stats AS
SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
    AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score)*AVG(cognitive_score) as cog_variance,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_rxn,
    AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms)*AVG(reaction_ms) as rxn_variance
FROM measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m, measurements_stats ms
WHERE 
    (ms.avg_cog - 3*SQRT(ms.cog_variance)) <= m.cognitive_score 
    AND m.cognitive_score <= (ms.avg_cog + 3*SQRT(ms.cog_variance))
    AND (ms.avg_rxn - 3*SQRT(ms.rxn_variance)) <= m.reaction_ms 
    AND m.reaction_ms <= (ms.avg_rxn + 3*SQRT(ms.rxn_variance));

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows FROM cleaned_measurements;
SELECT COUNT(*) as outlier_rows FROM measurements;

FROM measurements;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        cognitive_score,
        reaction_ms,
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score < cognitive_score) * 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score > cognitive_score) / 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements),
            AVG(cognitive_score)
        ) as avg_cog_est
    FROM measurements
),
q1 AS (
    SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as val FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 11 OFFSET 16
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as val FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 20 OFFSET 20
),
iqr_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score < cognitive_score) * 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score > cognitive_score) / 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements),
            AVG(cognitive_score)
        ) as avg_cog_tick,
        MAX(cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) as max_tick,
        AVG(cognitive_score) - MIN(cognitive_score) as min_tick
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m
CROSS JOIN q1
CROSS JOIN q3
WHERE m.cognitive_score >= q1.val - 1.5 * (q3.val - q1.val)
  AND m.cognitive_score <= q3.val + 1.5 * (q3.val - q1.val);

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * FROM measurements 
WHERE cognitive_score >= (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) - 2.0 * 
    (SELECT (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL) - 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL) * 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL)::REAL) 
    )
  AND cognitive_score <= (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) + 2.0 * 
    (SELECT (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL) - 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL) * 
            (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL)::REAL) 
    )
  AND reaction_ms >= (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) - 2.0 * 
    (SELECT (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL) - 
            (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL) * 
            (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL)::REAL) 
    )
  AND reaction_ms <= (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) + 2.0 * 
    (SELECT (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL) - 
            (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL) * 
            (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL)::REAL) 
    );

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m, (
    SELECT 
        avg_cog, cog_var, avg_rxn, rxn_var
    FROM (SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score)*AVG(cognitive_score) as cog_var,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_rxn,
        AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms)*AVG(reaction_ms) as rxn_var
    FROM measurements
)
) stats
WHERE 
    m.cognitive_score >= stats.avg_cog - 2*SQRT(stats.cog_var)
    AND m.cognitive_score <= stats.avg_cog + 2*SQRT(stats.cog_var)
    AND m.reaction_ms >= stats.avg_rxn - 2*SQRT(stats.rxn_var)
    AND m.reaction_ms <= stats.avg_rxn + 2*SQRT(stats.rxn_var);

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_original FROM measurements;
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cleaned FROM cleaned_measurements;

SELECT m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms, m.status, m.notes
FROM measurements m
LEFT JOIN cleaned_measurements cm ON m.session_id = cm.session_id
WHERE cm.session_id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.cognitive_score;
